import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from brute import check
cases = [
 ('(endswith(C,C,C) or (match(B,B) or not(endswith(B,A,A)))) allow; match(A,B) allow; endswith(C) allow; (startswith(A,A,A) and endswith(B,A,A)) allow;', ['A','B','C']),
 ('not(contains(B)) allow; not(not((contains(B,B,B) and endswith(A,B,C)))) allow; (startswith() and match(B,B)) drop;', ['A','B','C']),
 ('not(contains()) drop; endswith(B,A,C) allow; (match() or contains(B,B,B)) drop; startswith(C,A,A) drop;', ['A','B','C']),
 ('not((endswith(A,D,C) or match())) allow; match(B,D) drop; (contains(D,C,C) or match(D)) allow;', ['A','B','C','D']),
 ('not((endswith() and not(contains(A,A,C)))) drop; startswith(B,C) drop; (contains(D,B,A) or contains(D,B,A)) allow;', ['A','B','C','D']),
]
for text, names in cases:
    for d in (6, 8, 10, 12):
        err = check(text, names, limit=8, depth=d)
        print(d, 'FAIL' if err else 'ok', err or '')
    print('---')
EOF
